# Quantum Entanglement for a 5-Year-Old

Imagine you have two magic coins that are best friends!

When you flip one coin and it lands on heads, the other coin - no matter how far away it is - will instantly land on tails. They're connected by invisible magic!

It's like if you had a pair of magic gloves: when you put the left glove on your hand, the other glove instantly "knows" it has to be the right glove, even if it's on the other side of the world.

**The special part:** The coins don't decide what they're going to be until you look at one of them. Before you look, they're both everything at once! But the moment you peek at one, they both instantly choose what to be - and they always choose opposites.

Scientists call these special paired things "entangled," which means tangled up together in a way we can't see.

Pretty cool, right? Even Albert Einstein thought it was so strange he called it "spooky!" 👻
